name: CHEG 3394
title: Advanced Chemical Engineering Seminar
description: Students in this class will participate in the Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering seminar series to see a broader range of the topics covered in the chemical engineering profession. The exact topics covered by this course will vary by semester.
requirement_description: Not open for credit to students who have passed CHEG 4995 when offered as "Advanced CHEG Seminar."
